value.rationale: Provides a parameter-uniform exact endemic burden rank in a natural two-community network class, a smallest six-vertex strict inversion of intuitively used isolated spectral vulnerability rankings, and a constructive three-cell obstruction. This resolves how threshold ranks do and do not predict long-run expected infection for the motivating mathematical model, without claiming significance beyond the stated scope.
